name: Differentiable Triangle Splatting
definition: A method that develops a differentiable rendering pipeline enabling direct optimization of triangles through end-to-end gradients, leveraging the full compatibility of triangles with current rendering pipelines.
summary: Differentiable Triangle Splatting is a real-time renderer that optimizes 3D triangles via end-to-end gradients, surpassing Gaussian methods in fidelity and speed by using a single smoothness parameter for consistent spatial influence.
